units.source_text: 左马头详谈纵论，终无定见，不禁感慨叹息。

en.t: The Captain of the Left Stable discussed the matter at length, but in the end reached no firm conclusion and could not help sighing with emotion.

units.source_text: 过后又说：“如此看来，还不如不讲门第高下，更不谈容貌美丑，

en.t: Afterward he said again, "Seen in this light, it would be better not to speak of high or low birth, and still less of beauty or ugliness,

units.source_text: 但求其人性情不甚乖僻，为人忠厚诚实，稳重温和，便可信赖为终身伴侣。

en.t: but only to hope that the person is not too eccentric in temperament, is honest and sincere in character, steady and gentle, and can therefore be trusted as a lifelong companion.

units.source_text: 此外倘再添些精彩的才艺，高尚的趣致，更是可喜的额外收入。

en.t: If, beyond that, she also has some brilliant accomplishments and refined tastes, those are all the more a delightful extra gain.

units.source_text: 即使稍有不如人之处，也不会强求补充吧。

en.t: Even if she falls a little short of others in some respects, one would hardly demand that these deficiencies be forcibly made up.

units.source_text: 只要是个忠诚可靠的贤内助，外表的风情趣致后来自会增添。

en.t: So long as she is a loyal, dependable, and capable wife, outward charm and grace will naturally come to her later.
